text_blocks.label: trust-wording-scrub
text_blocks.text: Runnable examples are generated only from approved docs-channel records. Production claims are scrubbed unless source truth and publication gates allow them.

text_blocks.label: private-surface-boundaries
text_blocks.text: RRE, Prolog/Scryer, Cedar, CLIPS v2 rows, Pydantic v2, TypeScript/Zod, and Node wrapper preview remain private/static/planning/source-truth-bound without public runtime or support authority.

text_blocks.label: w198-denial-vocabulary
text_blocks.text: The scan denies `public-docs`, `docs-allowed`, `downstream-emission`, `provider-registry`, `package-publication`, `npm-ready`, `release-ready`, `public-ready`, and `generated-artifact` as authority fragments.

hosted_ai_indexes.label: llms-preview-boundary
hosted_ai_indexes.text: Hosted AI indexes must include routed public docs only and must not include private specs or dry-run packets.
